spans: This Exhibit B is entered into as of the 26th day of March 2020 by and between Kubient, Inc. ("Kubient"), and The Associated Press ("Customer").
This Exhibit is hereby incorporated into and made a part of the Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") between the Parties (Effective Date: February 5, 2020).
This Exhibit B is entered into as of the 26th day of March 2020 by and between Kubient, Inc. ("Kubient"), and The Associated Press ("Customer").

notes: This file is Exhibit B and Schedule 1 to Exhibit B of the Master Services Agreement between Kubient and The Associated Press, not the MSA's main body, so Governing Law, Expiration Date, Anti-Assignment, License Grant, Cap on Liability, Audit Rights, Insurance, IP Ownership Assignment and Non-Compete have no responsive clause in this text (the NON-CIRCUMVENT and NON-SOLICITATION clauses present are neither Non-Compete nor License Grant under the operational rules). Agreement Date is answered as this Exhibit's own dating (26 March 2020); the underlying Master Services Agreement's stated Effective Date is 5 February 2020.
